title: Happy butterfly
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad1' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8C00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad2' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF69B4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF1493'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad3' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00CED1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#008B8B'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad4' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7CFC00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#228B22'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Upper left wing -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='32' rx='24' ry='20' fill='url(#wingGrad1)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='32' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#FFE44D' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='28' r='4' fill='#FF4500'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='3' fill='#FF4500'/>

  <!-- Upper right wing -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='32' rx='24' ry='20' fill='url(#wingGrad2)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='32' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#FF85C8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='28' r='4' fill='#C71585'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='36' r='3' fill='#C71585'/>

  <!-- Lower left wing -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='62' rx='18' ry='16' fill='url(#wingGrad3)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='62' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#40E0D0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='60' r='3' fill='#006060'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#006060'/>

  <!-- Lower right wing -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='62' rx='18' ry='16' fill='url(#wingGrad4)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='62' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#90EE90' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='60' r='3' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#1B5E20'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='5' ry='22' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='20' fill='#D2691E'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='7' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='5.5' fill='#D2691E'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='30' r='2' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='30' r='2' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='29.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='29.5' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Happy smile -->
  <path d='M46 34 Q50 38 54 34' stroke='#1a1a2e' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Antennae -->
  <path d='M47 26 Q42 16 38 12' stroke='#D2691E' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <path d='M53 26 Q58 16 62 12' stroke='#D2691E' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>

  <!-- Wing dots -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='38' r='2' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='24' r='2' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='38' r='2' fill='#FF85C8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='24' r='2' fill='#FF85C8'/>

  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='2' fill='#FF69B4' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='36' r='2' fill='#FF69B4' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
